# has contributor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasContributor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a creative work to an agent that contributed to it — the flat 80%-case shortcut. Non-functional: a work may have many contributors. Promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) node when the role, period, confidence, or evidence of the contribution must be recorded.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case — naming a contributor when the role is generic or obvious and no period, degree, confidence, or evidence needs recording; the parent of the typed shortcuts ([`gmeow:hasAuthor`](gmeow-hasAuthor.md), …).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when a specific role applies (use the typed subproperty) or when the credit's role, period, degree, confidence, or evidence must be first-class — promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) relator.

### How to use

- Assert the most specific typed shortcut available ([`gmeow:hasAuthor`](gmeow-hasAuthor.md), [`gmeow:hasTranslator`](gmeow-hasTranslator.md)) and let [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md) follow by inheritance; it [`pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) — promote when metadata is required.
